title: Late Application Charges Are Not Waived by Meal Status: Seat Waiver Terms of Student Transportation Services
content:
Meal-status fee waivers of Student Transportation Services never reach a late application charge, which is not a fee for service. In the seat waiver the application charge the fee carries is taken out of the seat fee before the status share is applied. It follows the day the application was received on the assignment:

| Application received on the assignment | Application charge |
|---|---|
| after the permit period's first school day (August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester fee; January 6, 2027 for a spring semester fee) | 25.00 USD |
| for a school-year or fall semester fee, after July 15, 2026 and on or before August 12, 2026 | 15.00 USD |
| any other application | none |

## Both sides (hypothetical school-year applications)

| Received | Charge |
|---|---|
| July 15, 2026 | none |
| July 16, 2026 | 15.00 |
| August 12, 2026 | 15.00 |
| August 13, 2026 | 25.00 |

A spring semester application received on January 6, 2027 carries none; one received on January 7, 2027 carries 25.00.

## Example (hypothetical)

A seat fee of 171.00 USD on an application received in September 2026 carries a 25.00 charge; the seat waiver acts on 146.00.
